app.lander.hero.title: The AI coding agent for PLC Structured Text.
app.lander.features.native_tui.title: IDE-native
app.lander.features.native_tui.descripti: Bridges directly into CODESYS, TwinCAT, and TIA Portal. Your project stays canonical in the IDE — no new editor to learn.
app.lander.features.lsp_enabled.title: IEC 61131-3 fluent
app.lander.features.lsp_enabled.descript: Fine-tuned on the actual ST language reference. Knows pragmas, FB lifecycle, init slots, shadowing — the silent quirks generic LLMs miss.
app.lander.features.multi_session.title: Spec → code
app.lander.features.multi_session.descri: Upload a controls spec PDF. Volt generates function blocks that match your existing conventions and compile clean.
app.lander.features.shareable_links.desc: Compiles, reads diagnostics, iterates. Surfaces the diff for you to approve. No silent overwrites.
app.lander.features.github_copilot.descr: Speaks MCP. Use Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP-aware client — Volt is the PLC-shaped backend.
app.lander.features.chatgpt_plus_pro.des: Local-first bridge runs on the engineer's machine. No source code leaves your network without explicit push.
app.lander.features.use_any_model.title: Use any model
app.lander.features.use_any_model.suffix: Volt provides the PLC expertise, not the model.
